translations.web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
translations.bsb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
translations.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
